scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.services:start: mkdir -p logs && npx pm2 start ecosystem.config.cjs --update-env
scripts.start:all: node scripts/ensure-services.js && concurrently --restart-tries -1 --restart-after 2000 -n admin,site -c blue,green "npm start --prefix ../x-bilsenter-admin" "npm start"
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production npm start
